messages:
Lina Gomez: Quick flag  vendor interviewers onboarded via the new 'vendor-provision' flow are not seeing the benefits disclosure link in the ATS panel. Several vendor reps asked HR during prep.
Harold Price: saw a ticket this morning. vendor accounts show up as 'internal' in the UI, which hides the external-only disclosures.
Yuki Tanaka: that's alarming. Does the provisioning webhook include an employment_type field?
Rae: i checked the webhook payload yesterday. vendor-provision omits employment_type and sets role="interviewer_temp". Our UI logic assumes missing employment_type => internal.
TalentBot: Incident opened: INC-2026-1011  vendor-interviewer-disclosure-missing. Assigned: eng-ops + people-ops.
Lina Gomez: impact: vendor interviewers didn't get the benefits/NDAs prompt and some couldn't access the vendor onboarding guide. Also one vendor asked about expense reimbursement policy during prep call.
Harold Price: also noticed: feedback routing from those interviews routed to the hiring manager's personal inbox instead of the vendor-team mailbox. Likely because the feedback webhook used the wrong recipient mapping for role="interviewer_temp".
Yuki Tanaka: quick mitigation: we can update the UI to show disclosures whenever account has tag "vendor" regardless of employment_type. Rae, can you add a temp flag?
Rae: yes, I can add a feature-flip: show_vendor_disclosure=true for sessions created via vendor-provision. Small change, hotfixable.
eng-ops-bot: Note: deploying minor UI flag requires a 15-min release window.
Lina Gomez: please prioritize. Recruiters are getting questions and it's messy when ops has to manually email disclosures.
Harold Price: longer-term: fix the source system so webhook includes employment_type and vendor boolean. Then update routing table to map (employment_type, vendor_flag) -> feedback_destination.
Yuki Tanaka: I can push a schema change: add employment_type with enum {internal, contractor, vendor, agency}. Backward compatible default to "internal" but we'll also set vendor=true for vendor-provisioned flows.
Rae: plan: 1) temp UI flag to surface disclosure + send manual disclosure email (ETA: today EOD) 2) webhook schema change + routing table update (ETA: next sprint) 3) audit existing vendor accounts and backfill the disclosure_sent flag.
Lina Gomez: can recruiting ops run the backfill CSV and email batch after the UI flag is live? We have about 18 affected people this week.
Harold Price: Yup, i'll run the CSV and send templated disclosure emails. Can you add the backfill to the playbook so it's repeatable?
Rae: Posting the small SQL I'm going to run for the backfill (devs, review please):
```
-- mark vendor accounts missing disclosure
UPDATE accounts a
SET disclosure_sent = true, disclosure_sent_at = now()
FROM vendors v
WHERE a.id = v.account_id
  AND a.disclosure_sent = false;
```
Yuki Tanaka: looks good. For the routing fix, here's the mapping change we'll apply: feedback_dest = CASE WHEN vendor=true THEN 'vendor-feedback@redwood.com' ELSE existing_map END. I'll add a migration.
eng-ops-bot: INC-2026-1011 status -> in_progress. Hotfix window scheduled in 30m.
Lina Gomez: please add a note in the recruiter playbook: "If vendor interviewer can't find benefits link, escalate to people-ops and use vendor-feedback@redwood.com". Also add a one-liner to verify disclosure_sent after provisioning.
Harold Price: i'll update playbook and send a short blurb to the recruiter rotation.
Rae: hotfix deployed to staging. Will promote to prod after 15-min window. Posting PR: github.com/redwood/ats/pull/1307  vendor-disclosure-flag.
Lina Gomez: thanks. One more ask: can we add a quick checkbox on the scheduling modal "Vendor interviewer - show disclosure" so recruiters can override when necessary?
Yuki Tanaka: good idea. i'll add it to the next UI iteration. For now, the flag should cover most cases.
TalentBot: Reminder: affected sessions list generated  18 accounts. Sending CSV to people-ops.
Harold Price: Received CSV, will run manual emails after prod hotfix.
Lina Gomez: appreciate it. Please post when hotfix is live and when emails are sent so we can close INC-2026-1011.
eng-ops-bot: Hotfix deployed to prod. Backfill queued.
Rae: backfill finished; 18 disclosures sent. Adding incident postmortem to the ops-docs.
Lina Gomez: closing loop, thanks team.
